$comment: The allowlist of documents the site publishes from docs/. A file is published by appearing here, never by existing there. `name` is the document; `dir` is its directory under docs/, and an entry without one sits at the root; `slug` overrides the site path, which is otherwise `<dir>/<name>`; `locales` defaults to both. An entry with `repo` publishes `docs/<name>.md` from that gimhq repository (English only), fetched from GitHub at build time. Groups are the sidebar's, in order.
